Marta (People Ops): Quick follow-up from the all-hands open-floor Q&A about promotions, timing, and confidentiality. Dropping short answers here.

Devon: When do promo notices go out? Expected week?

Marta (People Ops): Managers will notify people between May 2-8. If you don't get a note by May 9, DM me and I'll check.

Kai (Eng Manager): If an IC was on out-of-office during calibration, can managers submit late evidence?

Marta (People Ops): Yes — late packets are accepted with a brief manager note. Ask to have docs in by Apr 30 to keep the process smooth.

Lina: Are we changing criteria for L3->L4? Heard rumors.

Arjun (CTO): No change to level criteria. We're emphasizing clearer impact statements in packets, not stricter bars. Managers, please include scale + outcomes.

Devon: Appeals process quick recap? Timeline?

Marta (People Ops): Appeals open for 14 days after notice. Send to appeals@redwood.com with the packet and concise rationale. People Ops triages within 5 business days.

Kai (Eng Manager): Any guidance on communicating decisions to teams to avoid rumor?

Marta (People Ops): Best practice: 1) Tell the individual privately first; 2) Manager decides team announcement cadence; 3) Keep packet details confidential. We have a short comms template in the toolkit.

people-ops-bot: Docs: https://redwood.internal/hr/reviews-toolkit (packet template v2)

Lina: Thanks — where to ask privately?

Marta (People Ops): DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com for sensitive questions. We'll post anonymized example packets Monday.
